title: Browser addon launcher implementation and test convention
answers: How to add support for a new browser in the Browser addon?
Where should new browser launch commands and binary paths be added?
What tests are required when adding browser support to test_browser.py?
body:
Supported browsers in mitmproxy/addons/browser.py:Browser must be dispatched from Browser.start to a dedicated launch_<browser> method.
Launchers must search executable paths across operating systems via find_executable_cmd with a find_flatpak_cmd fallback, logging an ALERT if no executable is found.
In test/mitmproxy/addons/test_browser.py, each browser launcher requires two async tests: test_browser_start_<name> (verifying subprocess.Popen execution) and test_browser_start_<name>_not_found (verifying the unsupported platform alert).
says: Add support to automatically launch an isolated session in a new web browser.
Clicking the start browser button shows an alert saying the browser was not found.
Support launching Linux Flatpak browser installations directly from the proxy interface.
The browser launcher fails to detect installed browsers on certain operating systems.
